_readme: Let the scheduled continuation job wake an original session after a subscription quota stop (`openclaw agent`), as if the owner had said 'continue'. That command is accepted only from accounts listed in commands.ownerAllowFrom: the owner and every bot account except the Desktop operator (the desktop role has its own queue-based continuation). Use the same user IDs as in config/crew.json. All bots are listed (not only the ones that need waking) also so that every bot can call the Desktop operator to use the computer tool; the Desktop operator itself is left out.
